check_data_availability.description: Find out what a selection of an OECD dataset holds without downloading it: how many values, the first and last dates, the latest period, and which values of each dimension still have data. Use it to check that a new month or quarter has been published before fetching it, or to see which countries a measure covers.

get_data.description: Get figures from any OECD dataset. Choose the dataset, pick values in the Filters (several countries at once if you like) and a period or the latest few values. Comes back as rows to loop over or add to a spreadsheet, each with its period, value, unit and every dimension's code and label, and as series with their latest value. A pasted Data Explorer link brings its selection with it. Every result carries a citation.

description: Read the OECD's official statistics straight from its own data API: about 1,500 datasets on GDP, inflation, jobs, trade, interest rates, education, health, taxes and more for its 38 member countries and major partner economies, including the Economic Outlook's projections. Search datasets by words or topic, see how one is organised, check what it holds and fetch figures as labelled rows, or get the leading indicator, inflation, unemployment, GDP growth, interest rates or the OECD's forecasts for a country in one step. Each result comes with a citation. No account or API key required.
